shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
cat next.config.ts lib/products.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/products/[slug]/page.tsx' __agent_eval__/run.mjs tsconfig.json; git diff package.json

(PORT=3123 npx next start > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && \ for u in "/products/lamp?currency=EUR" "/products/lamp" "/products/vase?currency=EUR" "/products/lamp?currency=EUR" "/products/nope"; do echo "== $u"; curl -s -o /tmp/out.html -w "status=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n" "http://localhost:3123$u"; grep -oE '

[^<]*

|

(USD|EUR) [0-9.]+

|Loading [a-z ]+\.\.\.|

(Brass lamp|Stone vase)

' /tmp/out.html | tr '\n' ' '; echo done; pkill -f "next start" ; true

(PORT=3124 NEXT_PRIVATE_DEBUG_CACHE=1 npx next start > /tmp/start2.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && \
curl -s "http://localhost:3124/products/nope" | grep -oiE "could not be found|404" | sort -u; \
curl -s -o /dev/null "http://localhost:3124/products/lamp?currency=EUR"; curl -s -o /dev/null "http://localhost:3124/products/lamp?currency=EUR"; curl -s -o /dev/null "http://localhost:3124/products/lamp?currency=USD"; \
sleep 1; pkill -f "next start"; grep -iE "cache" /tmp/start2.log | head -20; true
grep -E "DefaultCacheHandler: get .*(lamp)" /tmp/start2.log; git -C /workspace diff tsconfig.json next-env.d.ts
